title: Replicate live read-only validation + verified cost table (Phase 3)

account.note: authenticated read-only; token never printed/logged/placed in argv or URL

billingMode.finding: Replicate offers BOTH a prepaid-credit model AND arrears billing (replicate.com/docs/topics/billing). The public API /v1/account exposes NO billing field (keys: type, username, name, avatar_url, github_url). The dashboard billing page is credentialed web (not safely machine-readable).
billingMode.ctoRule: Prepaid purchases / minimum purchase / auto-reload / subscriptions PROHIBITED; arrears-only.
billingMode.verdict: BLOCKED: cannot confirm arrears + auto-reload OFF from any read-only signal. Firing even a $0.003 probe could trigger prepaid auto-reload on a prepaid account. No paid call issued.

modelsVerifiedPresent.note: All return HTTP 200, visibility=public, latest_version present. Veo/luma-ray-flash-720p NOT found (404).

pricesNOTbounded.reason: Per-unit price is JS-rendered on each model page (absent from fetched HTML) and ABSENT from the API model object (only run_count). CTO forbids inferring from memory or unrelated providers (Runway/fal). Worst-case per call therefore NOT bounded from a first-party machine-readable source.

gates.costBounding: PARTIAL (image+i2v bounded; t2v video + tts NOT bounded)

conclusion: Phase 5 paid benchmark BLOCKED with €0 paid generation: (1) billing mode not verifiable as arrears/auto-reload-off; (2) t2v video + tts per-unit price not first-party bounded. Image models alone are fully bounded but cannot run until the billing-mode gate clears.
